eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Emerging Systems and Intelligent Computing (ESIC) provides a premier platform for researchers, academicians, industry professionals, and practitioners to present and discuss recent advances in intelligent computing and emerging technologies. The conference focuses on artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, cloud and edge computing, cybersecurity, Internet of Things, smart systems, robotics, intelligent networks, computational intelligence, and sustainable digital technologies. ESIC promotes interdisciplinary research, innovative solutions, and industry-academia collaboration to address real-world challenges and foster the development of next-generation intelligent systems and computing paradigms.
